cases.summary: Node Sync Progress Pop-up Not Showing Up on fresh installation of BTCPayServer using Azure quick-deployment
cases.description: **Describe the bug** I'm having a problem with BTCPayServer. I can replicate the problem by installing a fresh installation of BTCPayServer on an AzureVM. My BTCPay version is _v1.0.6.0 (altcoins)_, and I deployed my server on Azure by following the instructions on the [docs](https://docs.btcpayserver.org/AzureDeployment/) deployment guide (pretty straightforward), just had to click on the Azure Deploy button and fill in the inputs. My BTCPay Setup seems to be ok! The only problem is that it's not showing the node Sync pop-up on the bottom corner, as it used to do all the times I deployed using this method before. Here are the logs I was able to get from my BTCPay instance. You can see the error in the image I attached. **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to [Azure Deployment Docs](https://docs.btcpayserver.org/AzureDeployment/) 2. Click on `Deploy to Azure` button 3. Fill in the inputs on Azure portal 4. Browse your fresh installed instance of BTCPayServer 5. The node sync progress pop-up won't be there! **Expected behavior** I expected to see the progress of the node sync as usual. **Screenshots** **Your BTCPay Environment (please complete the following information):** - BTCPay Server Version: v1.0.6.0 (altcoins) - Deployment Method: Azure quick-deploy button - Browser: I have tested on Chrome and Sfari **Logs (if applicable)** Basic logs can be found in Server Settings > Logs.
